title: 22-Layer ZnS/MgF2 Dual-Band Filter with Empirical Thickness Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: The iteration 05 performance degradation (0.594 vs 0.955) resulted from thickness bounds [50,150]nm being physically incompatible with quarter-wave optical thickness at 3-5 μm wavelengths. Restoring bounds to [400,1600]nm range observed in iteration 01 successful candidates, with initialization centered on empirical mean thickness ~950nm from top performers, will recover high target scores while maintaining the proven 22-layer alternating ZnS/MgF2 topology.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack principle with alternating high/low index dielectrics; layer optical thickness approximately λ/4 at center of passbands. Empirical initialization from successful iteration 01 candidates preserves the thickness manifold that achieved 0.955 score.
proposed_topology: Air | [ZnS | MgF2] × 11 | CaF2 substrate; exactly 22 finite layers in alternating sequence
design_variables: All 22 layer thicknesses in nm, initialized from iteration 01 candidate mean thickness distribution with Gaussian perturbation σ=150nm
Optimizer step size reduced by 40% relative to iteration 05
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 3.25-3.35 μm and 4.20-4.30 μm passbands
Minimize mean transmittance in 2.50-3.10 μm and 4.45-5.00 μm stopbands
manufacturing_considerations: ZnS and MgF2 are conventional depositable IR dielectrics
Thickness ranges [400,1600]nm compatible with PVD deposition control
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack design principle for alternating index multilayers
Transfer matrix method for coherent thin-film interference calculation
Empirical thickness distribution from iteration 01 successful candidates
expected_advantages: Recover iteration 01 performance level (target score ~0.95) by restoring physically-appropriate thickness bounds
Empirical initialization reduces search space and prevents over-detuning
Reduced optimizer step size preserves multi-band margin feasibility
known_risks: Local optimization may converge to suboptimal thickness configuration
Spectral ripple may increase with 22-layer thickness
Deposition stress may cause thickness deviation from design
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer alternating ZnS/MgF2 multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate under normal incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS(1), MgF2(2), ZnS(3), MgF2(4), ZnS(5), MgF2(6), ZnS(7), MgF2(8), ZnS(9), MgF2(10), ZnS(11), MgF2(12), ZnS(13), MgF2(14), ZnS(15), MgF2(16), ZnS(17), MgF2(18), ZnS(19), MgF2(20), ZnS(21), MgF2(22). Initialize all 22 thicknesses from empirical mean of iteration 01 top candidates (approximately 950nm mean) with Gaussian perturbation standard deviation 150nm. Constrain thickness bounds to [400, 1600]nm per layer. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step size reduced by 40% relative to standard. Evaluate transmittance at four wavelength bands: passbands 3250-3350nm and 4200-4300nm (maximize), stopbands 2500-3100nm and 4450-5000nm (minimize). Score via equal-weight mean aggregation across bands. Air incidence, CaF2 substrate, no metal layers, coherent TMM solver. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Iteration 05 thickness bounds [50,150]nm were physically incompatible with quarter-wave requirements at 3-5 μm wavelengths, causing score drop from 0.955 to 0.594. This refinement restores bounds to [400,1600]nm matching iteration 01 successful candidates, initializes from empirical thickness manifold, and reduces optimizer step size per feedback directives.
